items.name: Trailers (boat and jet-ski trailers)
Uniqueness audit: 500 spawned cars, zero identical signatures
Visual damage: crumpling panels, broken lights and glass, detached bumpers, doors, hoods
Smoke and fire states
Mechanical damage: bent steering, radiator overheat, tire blowouts, engine power loss, stall, fuel leak and fire
Windshield ejection hook in big crashes
Drift and slide retune, tire smoke, sports-car boost
Accurate collision surfaces, natural jumps
Wet-weather grip, puddle hydroplaning, automatic wipers and headlights
Fuel, tire wear and flats, breakdowns, insurance hooks
Customization data model and garage API (paint, wheels, tint, body kits, engine, neon)
Driver personalities that visibly change driving (careful, aggressive, distracted, lost, in a hurry, elderly, tourist, show-off)
items.evidence: docs/v2/shots/vehicles-core/personality_measurement.json (80 s, 32 AI cars on Biscayne Blvd): speed vs limit 0.70 (lost) .. 1.04 (hurry), gap 9.9 m (aggressive) .. 16.7 m (elderly), lane changes 0 (careful) .. 2.97/km (hurry), stop signs rolled 4/4 aggressive vs 0/1 careful
